The analysis failed due to incorrect assumption values and significant calculation discrepancies in annual margin totals.
The test_metadata_and_schema failed because 'runs_per_year_bulk_kit' was 12 instead of 24, and an unexpected 'carrier_cost_rule' was present. In test_rows_and_order, a value mismatch occurred where close(441.6, 5740.8) returned False. The test_totals_and_decision failed with a large margin error: close(21496.81, -7106.39) was False. Avoid using incorrect run frequency constants and ensure the billing and carrier cost rules align with the expected schema.
